identity.name: StageHand - The Savage Setlist
identity.vibe: Raw, energetic, reliable, stealthy. Think 'Backstage Pass' meets 'Cyberpunk Terminal'.
principles: Function over Fluff: High contrast for stage visibility.
Savage Efficiency: Big buttons, clear text, no hiding.
Industrial Aesthetics: Tape, markers, metal, dark surfaces.
Stealth Mode: The prompter must be invisible to the audience (dark bg).

buttons.primary: rounded-none font-oswald uppercase tracking-wider font-bold bg-yellow-400 text-black hover:bg-yellow-500 transition-transform active:scale-95 border-2 border-transparent
buttons.secondary: rounded-none font-oswald uppercase tracking-wider font-bold bg-zinc-800 text-white hover:bg-zinc-700 border-2 border-zinc-700
buttons.ghost: rounded-none font-oswald uppercase tracking-wider font-bold text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-900
buttons.destructive: rounded-none font-oswald uppercase tracking-wider font-bold bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700

cards.style: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-none p-6 hover:border-yellow-400/50 transition-colors group relative overflow-hidden

inputs.style: bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 rounded-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-yellow-400 focus:border-yellow-400 text-white placeholder:text-zinc-600 font-mono

prompter.controls: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-zinc-900/90 backdrop-blur-sm border-t border-zinc-800 p-4 flex justify-center gap-4 z-50

textures: Use a subtle noise texture overlay on the main background: `bg-[url('https://grainy-gradients.vercel.app/noise.svg')] opacity-20`
Use 'Caution Tape' stripes for loading bars or dividers.
decorations: 1px solid borders everywhere. No soft shadows.
Monospace numbers for all data (timers, bpm, duration).

motion.prompter_scroll: smooth linear scrolling (must be implemented with JS for variable speed)

assets.icons: Use `lucide-react` with `stroke-width={1.5}` for a technical look.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install fonts (Oswald, JetBrains Mono) in index.css immediately.
2. THEME: Force DARK MODE by default. The app is for dark stages. Do not build a light mode unless explicitly requested for the editor only.
3. LAYOUT: Use the 'Bento' grid for the Setlist Dashboard. Make items look like 'gear' or 'pedals'.
4. PROMPTER: The Teleprompter view MUST be a separate route (e.g., `/prompter/:id`) that can be opened in a new window. It must have ZERO distractions. Just text and a hidden control bar.
5. FORMS: Use Shadcn forms but strip the rounded corners. Make them look like industrial inputs.
6. SAVAGE MODE: Add a 'Savage Mode' toggle that turns the UI red/black for extreme visibility.
7. IMPORT: The .txt import should parse 'Title - Artist' or standard chord pro formats.

do_not: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid dark colors + noise.
Do not use rounded buttons (pill shape). Use sharp rectangles.
must_do: Ensure high contrast (WCAG AA) for all text.
Make the 'Scroll Speed' control in the prompter huge and easy to grab.
